description: This file defines the GhostModel class, which manages API handlers, profiles, and interactions with different provider models for a chat or AI service. It includes methods for loading profiles, generating responses, and handling FIM (Fine-tuned Inference Model) support.

classes.name: GhostModel
classes.description: A class that manages API interactions, profiles, and response generation for different AI providers, supporting features like FIM and streaming responses.

methods.name: getFimHandler
methods.description: Retrieves the FimHandler from an ApiHandler if supported.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Loads or reloads the profile configuration, setting up the API handler accordingly.

methods.name: supportsFim
methods.description: Checks if the current API handler supports FIM.

methods.name: generateFimResponse
methods.description: Generates a FIM response using the FIM API endpoint, streaming chunks and calculating costs.

methods.name: generateResponse
methods.description: Generates a streaming response based on system and user prompts, tracking usage and costs.

methods.name: getModelName
methods.description: Returns the model ID of the current API handler.

methods.name: getProviderDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the current provider.

methods.name: getRolloutHash_IfLoggedInToKilo
methods.description: Returns the rollout hash if logged into Kilocode via KilocodeOpenrouterHandler.

methods.name: hasValidCredentials
methods.description: Checks if the API handler is initialized and credentials are valid.
